LanguageData.SDS_BasicSuperStorage.label: Super Storage Basics
LanguageData.SDS_BasicSuperStorage.description: Begin to perceive the existence of super dimensional space. Building a super dimensional core anchors a passage to it, turning super dimensional space into a storage container.
LanguageData.SDS_AdvancedSuperStorage.label: Advanced Super Storage
LanguageData.SDS_AdvancedSuperStorage.description: Gain a basic understanding of super dimensional passage technology. Building a super dimensional anchor increases the number of physical interfaces between super dimensional space and the rimworld.
LanguageData.SDS_PrecisionSuperStorage.label: Precision Super Storage
LanguageData.SDS_PrecisionSuperStorage.description: Further understand the physical basis of super dimensional space. Building a super dimensional stabilizer increases its capacity. Research the basic model of the super dimensional link implant: while on the same map as a super dimensional core, colonists can access the stored stock at any time.
LanguageData.SDS_AdvancedPrecisionSuperStorage.label: Advanced Precision Super Storage
LanguageData.SDS_AdvancedPrecisionSuperStorage.descri: Fully understand the nature of super dimensional space; the passage no longer depends on anchoring by a super dimensional core. Research the advanced model of the super dimensional link implant: colonists can cross map boundaries to access the stored stock at any time, and can draw directly on super dimensional storage when trading with other colonies.
